items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: When Stravinsky put the African rhythms back in to European music with Le Sacre du printemps in 1921 I think it was, it caused two days of rioting in Paris you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. It was the ballads or the European music is simply music with the rhythm removed. When Stravinsky put the African rhythms back in to European music with Le Sacre du printemps in 1921 I think it was, it caused two days of rioting in Paris you know.
Yeah. They didn’t know what to do with that.
